content.title: What Donald Trump Jr. Said About Vanessa Trump and Tiger Woods
content.text: This is what Donald Trump Jr. said about his ex-wife’s relationship with Tiger Woods.Mar 27, 2026 6:38 PM EDT Tiger Woods of Jupiter Links GC talks with his girlfriend, Vanessa Trump, after a match against Boston Common Golf at SoFi Center on March 17, 2026 in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. (Photo by James Gilbert/TGL/TGL Golf via Getty Images)Key PointsTiger Woods and Vanessa Trump's relationship is back in the spotlight after the pair packed on the PDA during the TGL FinalsWhen news of their relationship first broke, Donald Trump Jr. said he was "cool" with itPresident Trump also expressed support for the relationship Tiger Woods has remained in the public conversation in recent months. From whether he would perform in the Masters to his rollover car crash and subsequent DUI arrest, the renewed attention has circulated around his personal life and long-running ties to Vanessa Trump.Watch More Vanessa Trump has largely stayed out of the public spotlight since her divorce from Donald Trump Jr. in 2018. The former couple married in 2005 and share five children, and they have continued to co-parent since their split. When Did Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump Start Dating? When reports of Vanessa Trump’s connection to Woods first surfaced, Donald Trump Jr.’s reaction was notably understated. According to People, a source close to the family said his response to the news was simply: “cool.” Additional reporting from the time revealed that President Donald Trump was supportive of the relationship, expressing that he “loves” both Vanessa and Tiger and that he golfs with Tiger often and told him, “That’s good” when the golfer revealed his relationship with his former daughter-in-law. Trump Jr. has since moved on personally and has been publicly linked to other relationships, while Vanessa Trump and Woods recently made headlines when they displayed rare PDA at the TGL finals, just days before Woods was arrested for a DUI after a rollover car crash in Jupiter Island, Florida.
